scripts._dev_note: Trader removed from `dev` 2026-06-09 — now runs under launchd (com.cockpit.trader, see scripts/launchd/com.cockpit.trader.plist). The `trader` slot in concurrently is now a log-tail of the launchd trader's stdout (does NOT spawn a process). Use `pnpm dev:with-trader` only if launchd is unloaded; the launchd trader.sh singleton check will block accidental duplicates anyway.
scripts._split_note: SPLIT DEV (2 terminals): `pnpm dev:core` = aggregator + data pipeline (bookmap addon, tick-store, heatmap worker, auto-deploy, trader log-tail) — leave this running so CVD/delta data stays unbroken. `pnpm dev:cockpit` = cockpit Vite only — restart this freely. The two talk over HTTP/WS (Vite proxies to :8787), so restarting the cockpit never touches the aggregator's data flow. Do NOT run `dev`/`dev:core` at the same time — both bind :8787.
scripts._heatmap_note: HEATMAP + VOLUME-DOTS ENGINE DISABLED 2026-07-09 (Ravi). The heatmap:worker slot was removed from dev/dev:core/dev:with-trader below so the MBO-tailing engine no longer launches; the UI HEAT button is commented out in Chart.tsx. All code is intact. To REACTIVATE: re-add \"pnpm --filter @trading/aggregator heatmap:worker\" as an hm slot (name+color) to the concurrently lines, and un-comment the HEAT button block in apps/cockpit/src/components/Chart.tsx.
scripts.dev: concurrently -n agg,ui,bm,ticks,trader,deploy,fl,tp,dr -c blue,green,magenta,cyan,red,yellow,cyan,cyan,blue "pnpm --filter @trading/aggregator dev" "pnpm --filter @trading/cockpit dev" "python3 addons/bookmap/addon.py" "pnpm --filter @trading/tick-store dev" "tail -F ~/Library/Logs/cockpit-trader.stdout.log" "bash ~/auto_deploy_tick_addon.sh" "pnpm --filter @trading/aggregator flow:worker" "pnpm --filter @trading/aggregator tape:worker" "pnpm --filter @trading/aggregator drift:worker"
scripts.dev:core: concurrently -n agg,bm,ticks,trader,deploy,fl,tp,dr -c blue,magenta,cyan,red,yellow,cyan,cyan,blue "pnpm --filter @trading/aggregator dev" "python3 addons/bookmap/addon.py" "pnpm --filter @trading/tick-store dev" "tail -F ~/Library/Logs/cockpit-trader.stdout.log" "bash ~/auto_deploy_tick_addon.sh" "pnpm --filter @trading/aggregator flow:worker" "pnpm --filter @trading/aggregator tape:worker" "pnpm --filter @trading/aggregator drift:worker"
scripts.dev:with-trader: concurrently -n agg,ui,bm,ticks,trader,deploy -c blue,green,magenta,cyan,red,yellow "pnpm --filter @trading/aggregator dev" "pnpm --filter @trading/cockpit dev" "python3 addons/bookmap/addon.py" "pnpm --filter @trading/tick-store dev" "pnpm --filter @trading/trader dev" "bash ~/auto_deploy_tick_addon.sh"
scripts.pm2:restart: pnpm run build:cockpit && pm2 restart aggregator
